    assert response.headers["connection"] == "keep-alive"

I have successfully implemented the `SSEResponse` class in `fastapi/responses.py` and verified it with a test.

Summary of changes:
- Added `SSEResponse` class inheriting from `StreamingResponse`.
- Set default headers for SSE: `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Cache-Control: no-cache`, `Connection: keep-alive`, and `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.

The `SSEResponse` class has been added to `fastapi/responses.py` to provide built-in support for Server-Sent Events (SSE). This class inherits from `StreamingResponse` and automatically sets the necessary headers (`Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Cache-Control: no-cache`, `Connection: keep-alive`, and `X-Accel-Buffering: no`) to ensure compatibility with SSE standards and prevent buffering by proxies like Nginx. The implementation was verified using a targeted test case.
